edits.instructionEn: Remove the small distant sailing ship on the left horizon and restore its cloudy sky and water.
Erase the narrow waterspout funnel at the right horizon near x83 y20, leaving continuous clouds and waves.
Recolor only the broken wooden mast stump at the left side of the boat to blue; keep all ropes and geometry.

edits.descriptionKo: 배 위 찢어진 돛 천이 붉은색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor only the torn cream sailcloth lying atop the boat near x44 y45 to muted red, retaining folds and edges.

edits.descriptionKo: 선실 덮개의 오른쪽 판이 파란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Change the reddish wooden cabin hatch lid near x45 y53 to dark blue, preserving scratches and perspective.
Recolor the dark coiled rope at the left inside edge of the boat around x35 y55 to muted brick red.

edits.descriptionKo: 배 안 사탕수수의 초록 줄기는 빨강, 노란 부분은 초록으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Inside only this existing sugar-cane target, change the originally green stalk portions to vivid scarlet red and the originally yellow portions to vivid emerald green. Preserve orange or brown joints, dark outlines, stalk shapes, ropes, boat and every skin area. Do not flatten the whole bundle to one color.

edits.descriptionKo: 배 앞쪽의 작은 붉은 무늬가 없어졌어요.
edits.instructionEn: Remove the small red painted streak on the white bow near x54 y71, replacing it with the surrounding white hull paint.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 바다 위 작은 새들이 없어졌어요.
edits.instructionEn: Remove the group of three tiny pale flying birds over the water at right near x85 y46 and restore the sea.
Change only the tall triangular dorsal fin of the large foreground shark near x64 y74 to a short rounded fin; preserve the shark body and surrounding waves.
